script_text: Libra, a transformative transit arrives Monday that reroutes your path. Venus trines Jupiter in your eleventh House all week early, expanding friendships and unlocking a financial windfall from an unexpected source. Avoid Monday — the Moon squares Neptune, distorting love and money. Wednesday pivots everything when Mercury turns direct in the fifth House, awakening romantic momentum and creative desire. Thursday onward, the Sun enters your tenth House, signaling major career recognition and a conversation about your value. The weekend brings emotional calm — Sunday favors intimate connection over social events. Tuesday is your best day because Venus trines Jupiter in the eleventh House, amplifying charm and social magnetism in love and finances. Monday is your worst day because the Moon squares Neptune, clouding judgment and tempting reckless spending. Invest in one honest conversation this week — as an Air sign, your clarity will unlock doors in partnerships and career. Follow for daily updates.
